name: Grave Hush
description: Lay a grave hush over a clash of souls so that the weaker notes in it die away.

name: Curse Unmaking
description: Unmake a soul curse laid on an ally by cancelling its first word and each word that follows.

name: Throttle Surge
description: Throttle the surge of soul force in a foe until their technique gutters and fails.

name: Settling Lull
description: Settle a battered ally's soul in a deep lull that cancels the pain of a hundred small blows.

name: Vast Abatement
description: Abate every hostile soul force across a wide field as one great quiet settles over it.

name: Rebounding Quiet
description: Let a hostile soul wave strike the great quiet and rebound upon the host that sent it.

name: Weighing Silence
description: Weigh the soul force of an entire army in a wide silence and learn where it is heaviest.

name: Absolving Hush
description: Hush a whole company clean of curse and taint by cancelling every hostile mark upon it.

name: Ageless Hush
description: Cast an ageless hush over the field that cancels every hostile soul technique as it is born.

name: Mass Absolution
description: Absolve every ally on the field of soul curse and taint in one long breath of quiet.

name: Choking Silence
description: Choke the soul force of a whole foe host into silence until none can raise a technique.

name: Final Quiet
description: Let the final quiet of the school fall with a reach and hold set by the divine energy of its master.

name: Stilled Host
description: Still an entire allied host against soul attack with a hold set by the divine energy of the master.

name: Total Cancellation
description: Cancel every soul technique and soul force upon a battlefield up to the ceiling of a divine nullifier of this tier.

name: Draining Silence
description: Press a silence on every soul of a host that empties its force to the destructive ceiling of this tier.
